messages:
maria (CS): Heads up — escal from ACME. They see duplicated final sentences and a partial last chunk after an SSE reconnect. They say they were billed for both outputs. Logs attached.
acme-prod (customer): repro steps: open stream -> receive chunks seq 0..2 -> connection drops -> client reconnects within 800ms using SDK v0.9.2 with same `Resume-Token: rtk:abc123` -> server responds and we get chunk seq 2 again and finalization event, duplicate last sentence. Billing shows two generation charges.
acme-prod (customer): paste of client log snippet:
```
[2025-06-04T11:20:14.123Z] STREAM OPENED session=svc-44 resume_token=rtk:abc123
[2025-06-04T11:20:16.542Z] CHUNK recv seq=0
[2025-06-04T11:20:16.643Z] CHUNK recv seq=1
[2025-06-04T11:20:17.000Z] CHUNK recv seq=2 (partial)\n<socket closed>
[2025-06-04T11:20:17.820Z] RECONNECT using resume_token=rtk:abc123
[2025-06-04T11:20:18.010Z] CHUNK recv seq=2 (final)  <-- duplicate last sentence
```
Samir (Oncall): thanks — looking. First pass: server accepted the reconnect but appears to have a different internal resume epoch for that session. Can you attach the server side fragment for the same timeframe?
maria (CS): uploaded server logs to the thread: `server-frag-1743956789.log` (link in ticket). Key excerpt: 
```
[11:20:17.785] EXPIRE session=svc-44 lease=sidecar-a
[11:20:17.786] NEW_LEADER sidecar-b acquired session=svc-44
[11:20:17.789] RESUME_CHECK token=rtk:abc123 expected_epoch=5 current_epoch=6 accepted=true
[11:20:17.789] REPLAY start_seq=2
[11:20:18.009] CHUNK send seq=2 final=true
```
Samir (Oncall): hm — server shows `accepted=true` even though epoch changed (5 -> 6). That means the new sidecar accepted an older token and replayed from seq=2. If the client also re-sent the finalization event (or retried the final request after reconnect), we could get duplicate outputs.
Jinwoo (DevX): do we include the client-side idempotency token in the resume handshake? In this case they use the SDK which only sends `Resume-Token` header, not a per-request idempotency key for stream finalize.
Samir (Oncall): right — current resume semantics are: resume token encodes (session-id, last-seq, epoch) but we treat epoch as soft; we accept tokens if seq is within `resume_window` regardless of epoch mismatch. That allowed the new leader to resume and replay.
maria (CS): customer is asking for short-term mitigation and root cause fix. They want assurance they won't be billed twice.
billing-bot: found 2 tokenized charges for session svc-44 at 11:20:18. ChargeIDs: ch_01F, ch_01G. Potential duplicate detected by same session+adjacent seqs.
Jinwoo (DevX): short-term mitigation suggestions: 1) refund duplicate charge (manual), 2) add customer-side guidance: backoff before reconnecting by 1s to give sidecar handoff time, 3) server can return a `Resume-Conflict` (HTTP 409-like) when epoch mismatch is detected.
Samir (Oncall): long-term — change server policy to require token epoch match OR require a signed proof of last acked seq from client before replay. Also add metric `resume_accepted_with_epoch_mismatch` and a canary that returns `Resume-Conflict` for 5% traffic.
maria (CS): customer asked if we can provide a deterministic repro they can run internally. Can we produce a small script that simulates quick disconnect + reconnect and shows duplication?
Jinwoo (DevX): yes — simple curl-based SSE repro: 
```
# open stream
curl -H "Resume-Token: rtk:abc123" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream | sed -n '1,200p'
# kill socket after partial chunk, then immediately reconnect with same token
```
Jinwoo (DevX): I'll draft a more robust repro harness and share in this thread. Will also add notes about SDK version (0.9.2) behavior.
Samir (Oncall): action items: (A) billing to issue refund for ch_01G pending root cause, (B) runtime: implement strict-epoch canary + metric, (C) DevX: sample repro + SDK guidance, (D) CS: notify customer with ETA. I'll pick up runtime work — aiming a canary patch tonight (low risk) to return `Resume-Conflict` when epoch mismatch and resume_window contains seq > last_ack.
maria (CS): thanks team. ACME wants a follow-up in 2 hours. I'll send interim note and the refund confirmation when billing verifies. :thumbsup:
